detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You wanna Smash?

Unlock auto-hits, new hammers, size, speed and damage upgrades, no stone will be left unsmashed.

The prestige that comes with the Museum

Find Museum Tickets in the stones and spend them on the 50+ prestige skills to progress faster.

Fill the Museum With Visitors

Visitors never stop coming. As your collection grows, crowds fight their way into your museum just to pay you the hefty entrance fee.

History can wait, profit won't.

Every stone hides history and profit, don’t let it rest.

Features

  • 3D stone-smashing clicker / idle gameplay

  • 8 stones and their artifact groups, each from different eras and locations

  • 24 unique artifacts to discover

  • Upgrade your hammer and museum

  • Flip the Lucky Coin with every hit

  • 50+ Prestige skills with Museum Tickets, to get your auto hammer going

  • Visitors!

  • Atmospheric and soothing
